use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Groups words by their first letter and counts them.
pub fn group_counts(words: &[&str]) -> HashMap<char, usize> {
    let mut counts = HashMap::new();
    for word in words {
        if let Some(first) = word.chars().next() {
            *counts.entry(first.to_ascii_lowercase()).or_insert(0) += 1;
        }
    }
    counts
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn counts_by_initial() {
        let counts = group_counts(&["apple", "Avocado", "banana", ""]);
        assert_eq!(counts.get(&'a'), Some(&2));
        assert_eq!(counts.get(&'b'), Some(&1));
        assert_eq!(counts.len(), 2);
    }
}
